verdict.rationale: The pack has no vendor documentation of a dbt adapter or native dbt project support in BigQuery. Dataform is Google's own separate transformation service, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here. A community remark that pipe syntax is 'great for DBT macros' implies dbt is used with BigQuery but is not vendor-documented dbt support.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, dbt is a first-class citizen — a documented adapter or native dbt project support with vendor docs to match
